description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

RTX is an aerospace and defense company developing products for a safer, more connected world. The Software Engineering I role supports a team of Software and Systems engineers in designing, developing, and testing software features for flight management systems used in military helicopters and planes. The role also involves applying leadership, communication, coordination, and proactive collaboration skills to deliver quality products on time.
Software engineer developing and testing flight management system features for military aircraft

Responsibilities:
• Work within a team of Software and Systems engineers to design, develop, and test software features for flight management systems that are integrated into military helicopters and planes
• Integrate soft skills (leadership, communication, coordination, proactiveness) into a dynamic environment that provides quality and timely products to internal and external customers

Requirements:
• This job requires a U.S. Person. A U.S. Person is a lawful permanent resident as defined in 8 U.S.C. 1101(a)(20) or who is a protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3). U.S. citizens, U.S. nationals, U.S. permanent residents, or individuals granted refugee or asylee status in the U.S. are considered U.S. persons
• Bachelor's degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) major obtained by start date
• Experience with C, C++, ADA, and/or Python
• Experience may be obtained through on-the-job experience, research, coursework, or projects

Preferred:
• Ability to draft System and/or Software Requirements
• Pilot/Avionics Experience (i.e. Private Pilot, Aircraft Maintenance, DO-178 Certification)
• Prior RTX internship, co-op, or work experience
